Distress Tolerance Worksheet 6   (Distress Tolerance Handout 8)
Self-Soothing
Due Date:             Name:                                    Week Starting:
Describe two crisis situations that happened to you. Then describe your use of the self-soothing
skills.
CRISIS EVENT 1: Rate level of distress (0–100) Before:        After:
Prompting event for my distress (who, what, when, where): What triggered the state of crisis?

 Vision

 Hearing

 Smell

 Taste

 Touch
At left, check the skills you used, and describe here:
Describe the outcome of using skills:
Circle a number to indicate how effective the skills were in helping you tolerate the distress and
cope with the situation (keeping you from doing something to make the situation worse). Use the
following scale:
I still couldn’t stand
the situation, even
for one more minute.
I was able to cope somewhat,
at least for a little while.
It helped somewhat.
I could use skills,
tolerated distress, and
resisted problem urges.
